summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric utility listed via ADRs on the NYSE, filed a Form 6-K disclosing its board's resolution to repurchase up to US$30 million of its own shares. The buyback is capped at 10% of share capital, with daily volume limited to 25% of 90-day average trading. The maximum price is US$16 per ADR on the NYSE and AR$2,600 per common share on Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos. Execution may take place over 180 calendar days funded from optional reserves. The board believes the shares trade below fair value, targeting enhanced shareholder participation. Insiders are barred from selling during the program. Watch for repurchase execution pace and balance-sheet liquidity impact.
